title: MLS system audit — parameters, per-team ratings, data integrity, system health
trigger: After the xG-shrinkage bug (parameter tuned for the goals model, inherited by the xG model), Son asked for a thorough audit of that error class and the whole system.

parameter_audit.method: re-swept every tuned constant on the 162-match walk-forward UNDER THE CURRENT xG model
parameter_audit.RESULT_SHRINK=8: FLAGGED — kept improving toward the sweep edge, which led to the finding below
parameter_audit.XG_SHRINK_GAMES=6: the fix made earlier today; every k in 3-8 beats k=24 by ~0.007 (whole region, not a knife-edge)

FINDING_win_blend_is_damping_not_informa.interpretation: A FLAT prior beats the real win/draw/loss prior, so the deployed win% blend carries no team information — its whole benefit is damping an overconfident model.
FINDING_win_blend_is_damping_not_informa.honest_test: With alpha fitted WALK-FORWARD (only past matches, as production must), win% scores 1.0514 vs raw 1.0506 = -0.0007: the +0.0038 was hindsight from choosing alpha on the same 162 matches. Temperature likewise collapses from +0.0037 to +0.0001.
FINDING_win_blend_is_damping_not_informa.verdict: The win% blend is NOT a validated feature. Its label overstates what it does. Left deployed pending Son decision; effect is within noise either way.

per_team: all 30 teams: 100% xG coverage, ratings present, shrinkage now uniform ~40-45% (was ~76%). VAN correctly strongest, SKC weakest. No mis-rated team.
model_vs_market: 14 upcoming fixtures, mean max-disagreement 0.049; only 2 favourite-flips, both near coin-flips. MIN/VAN now agrees on direction.
data_integrity: 13 checks PASS (pairing, score agreement, xg_against mirroring, side attachment, orphans, GK flags, bridge uniqueness, fixture resolution). 1 FAIL -> All-Star fixture.

FINDING_all_star_readiness_blocker.issue: ESPN MLS feed includes MLS All-Stars vs Liga MX All-Stars (event 401864004, 2026-07-30). Non-club sides -> team ids NULL, no KXMLSGAME market. The readiness invariant would have counted it as an unmapped upcoming fixture and raised a BLOCKER (shadow_ready=false) when it entered the 48h window on Jul 28.
FINDING_all_star_readiness_blocker.fix: non-club fixtures excluded from the upcoming set (they are not shadow-predictable by construction); regression test fails without the fix. Deployed @832b2ff.

system_health: 470 backend tests + 6 e2e green; single migration head; 16/16 prod endpoints HTTP 200; money LOCKED (real_money_signals=false, nothing sets approved_for_real_money=True).
